reviews.title: UPGRADE AFTER TOWNHOUSE
reviews.text:
Hello Ms. Jeon,

Allow me to begin with my deepest admiration and gratitude for this app, which has so profoundly transformed the lives of my friends and me. Under your guidance, our little Charlie town has flourished beyond what I ever could have imagined. It has expanded and blossomed, becoming a beautiful testament to the power of discipline and collective accountability. 

Everyone is hitting their step goals. Everyone is exercising restraint with their donuts, spending them only when it serves the greater good of the house. We have worked so hard, Ms. Jeon. So very, very hard. 

However, I fear that we have reached the end of our journey. It appears that our beloved town can no longer be upgraded past Townhouse. I must confess something to you, Ms. Jeon. My friends and I were once fat. So very, very fat. This app has been our guiding light and our last defense against the temptations of our former gluttonous lives. Without the promise of a new upgrade, I worry we will slowly descend back into the darkness. Our step counts will dwindle. Our fat rolls will multiply. Our Charlie Town will crumble. 

Please, Ms. Jeon. I beg you. Do not abandon us at Townhouse. Keep my friends and me healthy. Keep us motivated. Give us something to strive towards. GIVE US AN UPGRADE BEYOND TOWNHOUSE BEFORE ITS TOO LATE!!!!

With love and the utmost admiration, 

Teagurz

reviews.title: Change in number of steps needed
reviews.text: I like this app. But 10,000 steps isn’t really beneficial. It’s just a myth. There’s studies that have been done that at least 5000 steps is good for gains. 7000 steps is also another sweet spot. Wish I could adjust the step goal though so it’s more achievable.

reviews.title: Cute waking app!
reviews.text:
I love using this app to motivate myself to walk more throughout the day! Also was very cute to gather up donuts to upgrade the houses until we maxed out with our townhouse😅

Now that my friends and I have upgraded to the townhouse and now, there’s nothing left to do with the donuts? It would be nice if we can buy things for the house (i.e accessories like Christmas lights, house pets, challenges within the house, etc). Or even if there was a way to build a town (i.e. parks, shops, other buildings). My friends and I have been starting to wonder what we can do now with the donuts because we are not ones to splurge on the clothes/accessories and was moreso using it to keep upgrading our home but now we have nothing to do.

reviews.title: WiFi reliance
reviews.text: The app is very well made, though I wish it could be used offline so that steps can be counted without connection.

reviews.title: Walking Charlie Review
reviews.text: I like the app, however, it chooses random days not to track any steps at all despite all other step apps, such as the general fitness app, will count steps for the same day. There seems to be no way to correct this.

reviews.title: Got my friends to join!
reviews.text:
I really enjoy the camaraderie you get when having a group of friends just tracking their steps. Before it felt fun on my own, but it’s better now with a small feeling of competition.

Originally i was trying to look fot an app similar to my company’s walking challenge after it ended. This one is much more fun with dressing up the character and daily goals.

One piece of feedback i guess I would have is possibly more daily/weekly goals. I feel more motivated when i see a new one popping up right when I complete one—“I guess I’ll do 1500 more steps”.

I think i saw one recently for the weekend as a push goal, if you had more similar I think it’ll help more people like me that enjoy the mystery box prizes 

Can’t wait to start getting back into running with this app🤗👍🏼

reviews.title: Glitch made me lose my streak
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this app at first as it is very cute and also surprisingly actually motivated me to walk 5,000 steps each day. I was getting into incredibly healthy habits. But then… one day, after my hard earned six pack, I found that for some reason, in the middle of the night (9pm) my Charlie had gained weight even though the day had not ended and I was on track to hitting 5k steps. After that something in me cracked and I lost all motivation. Now I have ceased walking that many steps a day. I feel robbed and cheated of my six pack.
